hero.description: I am a 2nd-year Computer Engineering student at Selçuk University and the HSD Selçuk Campus Ambassador. I build modern web interfaces with a strong engineering foundation and a keen awareness of cybersecurity.

about.p1: I am currently pursuing my degree in Computer Engineering at Selçuk University. I constantly bridge the gap between theoretical computer science—from algorithm complexity analysis in C to OOP in Java—and practical applications using modern front-end technologies.
about.p2: I serve as the President and Campus Ambassador for HSD Selçuk (Huawei Student Developers) for the 2026-2027 academic year. Additionally, I oversee software development at the Divizyon platform, focusing on user-centric and high-performance web architecture.
about.p3: While my primary technical focus is on Next.js and the React ecosystem, I have a deep-rooted interest in cybersecurity principles. For me, engineering isn't just about writing code; it's about knowing exactly what you are building, why you are building it, and how to keep it secure.
